data.gender_notes: Akbariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Akbariyah is an Arabic name for girls meaning great, grand. The name Akbariyah carries the meaning “Great, Grand” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Akbariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody great, grand and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: أكبرية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أكبر، يعني العظمة والكبر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أكبرية مشتق من كلمة أكبر، و هي تعني العظمة والكبر في اللغة العربية. و في الاصطلاح، يمكن أن يرتبط بالعظمة الإلهية أو الصفات الرفيعة. و قد وردت هذه الجذور اللغوية في القرآن الكريم في سياقات مختلفة، مما يعطيها عمقًا دينيًا وروحيًا.

in_urdu.name: اکبریہ
in_urdu.meaning: عظمت و بڑائی سے مشتق، عالی شان
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکبریہ نام عظمت و بڑائی سے مشتق ہے، جو عالی شان و مرتبت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اس کا تعلق عربی جڑوں سے ہے، جو اسلامی تقالید میں عظمت و جلال کے معنی رکھتی ہیں۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان الثقافتی و دینی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अक्बरिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक्बरिया नाम महानता और श्रेष्ठता की भावना को दर्शाता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में उच्चतम दर्जा और आध्यात्मिक महत्व को इंगित करता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: اکبریه
in_pashto.meaning: د ل greatness څخه مشتق، لوړه کچه
in_pashto.long_meaning: اکبریه نوم د greatness او لویوالی څخه مشتق دی، چی لوړه کچه او بزرگی معنی یې لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښتونو سره تړلی دی، او د دیني او فرهنګی اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Akbariyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'Akbar', meaning greatness and magnificence
in_english.long_meaning: Akbariyah is derived from the Arabic root 'Akbar', which signifies greatness, magnificence, and superiority. This name has its etymological roots in the Quranic context, symbolizing divine attributes and spiritual excellence. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, reflecting a sense of nobility, grandeur, and high moral character. The name Akbariyah embodies virtues of leadership, wisdom, and spiritual depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Akbariyah carries a sense of pride and excellence in the Muslim community, as the name implies "great" and "grand." It is a name consistently associated with ambition and achievement. Parents may choose to give this name to their child with the hope that they will grow up to be an exceptional leader, individual, or make significant contributions in their community or society. Additionally, it may be a nod to the memory of a prominent ancestor or revered historical figure, as a way to honor and preserve their legacy.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic and spiritual context, the name Akbariyah can be seen as a reminder of the concept of tawhid, the oneness of God. It is a subtler, more personal way to embrace and embody the idea of "the Greatest" - striving for greatness and excellence in one's spirituality can lead to a deeper and more meaningful connection with Allah. The quest for grandeur, in terms of moral and ethical character, can serve as a lifelong journey towards constant personal growth and self-improvement. This striving for personal excellence, rooted in one's faith, allows individuals to realize their fullest potential as sovereign vicegerents of Allah (caliphs of Allah), and in turn, actively contribute to creating a better world – one that reflects the divine mercy and compassion of the Most High.
